name: Irene
source:
Like with everyone else, you haven’t taken a great liking to your father’s new wife Irene. She is a tough and savvy woman, though, you can’t deny that. And there may be more to her than meets the eye, but you don’t know if you really want to find out.

*Freely adapted from official site
